Five complete AB/BA interleaved pairs with a fixed declared warmup and sample population; randomize pair ordinal in a predeclared seed, keep all ordinals. No first-pair selection or post-hoc trimming. Attribute with separate sparse probes; decisive pairs uninstrumented. Record device completion and host wall separately. If counters are used, require complete valid candidate/control populations; a crashed profiler produces no counter claim. Complete per-task taken/ready/done/worker/XCD stamps and actual event producer counts, queue predecessor edges, each body-duration distribution and exact output bytes. Phase-envelope overlap alone is not a causal price.
experiments.decision_stop_rule: Optional only if a coalesced multi-request scheduling framework remains a live implementation choice. Call scheduling dominant for the NEW isolated deficit only if restoration recovers >half that simultaneously measured deficit,all pairs positive and median>2*range. A miss closes this repair for this subgraph; no claim about all batching. Large body-duration changes require contention attribution.
experiments.risk_and_cost_rationale: Separates the strongest source-supported old failure mechanism from new shared-column math. It is not needed to establish that old whole-layer code lacked expert union, which is already proved locally. Skip if no implementation decision depends on coalescing.
experiments.preparation_before_gpu_authorization: Build resident-input/common-resource subgraph driver, exact event-count/epoch/visibility checks and local queue reachability proofs. Not implemented; no executable command invented. Do not reload a full model for every pair.
